svg.title: Oceanographer — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as oceanographer, wearing a raincoat and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A long cable lowers an open sampling probe beneath a visibly wavy ocean surface. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
